games-perf: ON HIS ORDER ("fix me being teleported back to the top of the mountain") I edited your hand-off paths — WorldRoom.ts startHandoff/hotStateFor/takeHandoff(+takeHandoffCopy)/onJoin, WorldScene.ts zoneGo + the hop row, shared JoinOptions — and released them (ed0f452901). THE CAUSE, from the beacon: both backwards jumps carried seq 0 + the whole predLog pending and came within a minute of a new revision going live. A hop's join is a NEW connection: during a rollout it lands on the new instance while the old one (draining his socket) holds the hand-off document in its in-process bus — takeHandoff found nothing, onJoin fell to an ordinary join, and that restores the account's last save (the previous hop's adoption save or the 30 s flush: 20-70 s old, up the mountain). Your b0b94c3212 covers the shutdown save; this is the OTHER rollout path (the hop lands on the new instance before the old one shuts down). THE FIX: zone:go also carries the hot state (minus rec/mintedSecret) signed HMAC-SHA256 under a server-wide secret claimed via the account store's claimLogin (first-writer-wins, atomic in Firestore, no env var — the constraint being no laptop); the client presents it on the hop join; a receiving room whose bus has no document adopts from the copy (valid sig, this pid+key, age <= HANDOFF_TTL_S, the account the client's own claim resolves to). The bus document stays first choice (fresher, per-tick). A hop that adopts nothing is logged server-side and the client replays nothing into it (cold) instead of 12 s of inputs; hop rows carry baseSeq/behind/replayed/cold (allowlist 24). Gate: handoffcross.test.ts (the receiving room's bus blinded to hand-off keys — deleting the doc is not enough, the sender rewrites it every tick). NOTE: CLAUDE.md was 20 bytes over its 20 KB test (lawsize.test.ts red on main since b0b94c3212's line); I trimmed my own lines to get it under — please keep it under when you add. Also the remaining lag on the timelines is yours: prefetch 419 ms, rebuildScenery 344, redrawGround 227, depthSort 150 (stalls), a tap 196 ms busy (ontouchstart 102 + ontouchend 90, repath 90) — every one inside a named region, waits ~1.6 ms a frame.
